We need to construct a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (list). Need to pick one that can be further processed with next template 1914389, etc.

We need to produce a JSON route with hierarchy: root molecule (target), child reaction (template 29646) with its precursors as children molecules. Then each of those precursor molecules may have further reactions using next templates.

But the requirement: route must have at least 5 reactions, using templates in this order. Likely a linear chain: each step applies next template to one of the precursors, leading to next precursors, etc. So we need to produce a linear sequence of 5 reactions, each using the specified template ID, ending with some buyable starting materials (maybe not required). We need to ensure each application succeeded (i.e., we have precursors). We have some results.

Let's examine the first apply_template result for 29646:

Result: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C',))"

So three possible precursors. The third one is simpler: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C". That seems like a smaller molecule lacking protecting groups. Let's use that as the branch.

Now apply template 1914389 to that precursor. We attempted earlier with that SMILES and got empty result. So maybe need to use a different precursor that works with 1914389. The first two have silyl protecting groups; earlier we applied 1914389 to a silyl-protected version and got some precursors (including "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C" and "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC"). So we can continue with that.

Thus route: Step1 (29646) -> choose precursor A = "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C". Then step2 (1914389) applied to that gave two precursors: B1 = "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C" and B2 = "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC". We need to continue linear chain, so pick one that can be processed by next template 1914390. We tried applying 1914390 to B1 and got product "CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1C[C@H](O)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](/C=C(/C)C(=O)OC)O1". Good. So step3 (1914390) on B1 yields C.

Now step4 template 149040 applied to C gave no result. So maybe need to apply 149040 to a different molecule (maybe B2?). Let's try applying 149040 to B2.
